# Retrieving Autogenerated Keys in LiveSQL INSERT

A. Cases for single-row INSERT (VALUES...) with no PK retrieval:

1. View -- No retrieval
2. Table with no PK -- No retrieval
3. Table with composite PK -- No retrieval
4. Table with single-column PK, but no auto-generation -- No retrieval

B. Cases for single-row INSERT (VALUES...) with PK retrieval:

5. Table with single-column PK with sequence generation --
6. Table with single-column PK with identity always generation --
7. Table with single-column PK with identity by default generation --

C. Cases for multi-row INSERT (SELECT...) with no PK retrieval:

8. View -- No retrieval
9. Table with no PK -- No retrieval
10. Table with composite PK -- No retrieval
11. Table with single-column PK, but no auto-generation -- No retrieval

D. Cases for multi-row INSERT (SELECT...) with multi PK retrieval:

12. Table with single-column PK with sequence generation --
13. Table with single-column PK with identity always generation --
14. Table with single-column PK with identity by default generation --
